usedFor: Landbot runs chatbots, and “Create a MessageHook” adds a hook to a channel while “Delete a Customer” removes one.

bestTemplate.name: “Create a MessageHook” in Landbot
bestTemplate.why: It adds a new MessageHook, so chatbot setup can be done without opening Landbot.

watchOut: “Delete a Channel” and “Delete a Customer” need the channel ID or Customer Id and remove it.
